_what: The citation UCDP asks for, read from UCDP's own documents on 2026-09-25, stored so that
nothing built on UCDP data is published without it. Read by core/ucdp_client.citation().
Text is as extracted from the PDFs. Two kinds of normalisation, both stated here:
(1) run-splitting spaces inside words were removed ('Datase t' -> 'Dataset', '202 6' -> '2026');
(2) in the GED 26.1 codebook the citation is set in an embedded font whose code map omits
three glyphs; those were INFERRED from the words around them and are listed under
'inferred_glyphs'. Every word and number was decoded from the PDF, not supplied from memory.

candidate_events.applies_to: UCDP GED Candidate monthly/quarterly releases (26.0.7, 26.0.8, 26.01.26.06) - the data behind the institution #0 rows
candidate_events.please_always_cite: Hegre, Håvard, Mihai Croicu, Kristine Eck, and Stina Högbladh, July 2020. Introducing the UCDP Candidate Events Dataset Research & Politics doi: 10.1177/2053168020935257
candidate_events.also_cite_codebook: Högbladh Stina, 2026 UCDP Candidate Events Dataset Codebook, v.1.5 Uppsala University.
candidate_events.release_schedule_stated: Data extracted from UCDP systems on the 20th of every month

ged.please_always_cite: Sundberg, Ralph, and Erik Melander, 2013, “Introducing the UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset”, Journal of Peace Research, vol.50, no.4, 523-532
ged.also_cite_codebook: Högbladh Stina, 2026, “UCDP GED Codebook version 26.1”, Department of Peace and Conflict Research, Uppsala University
ged.version_rule: Always include the Version number in analyses using the dataset.

inferred_glyphs.0x0355: ',' (comma) - unmapped in the font's code map; every place it stands a comma is the only reading

api_terms.verbatim: Usage is governed by the following limit: 5,000 requests per day. Errors count towards the limit.
